title: Spurs take pole position for playoffs
heading: 2003-04 Power Rankings: Week 24

rankings.summaryHtml: Running out of time to snatch the divison title from Minnesota, Spurs can still point to a nine-game win streak -- with an average victory margin of 13.7 points -- that suggests they're looking better than decent as the playoffs approach.
rankings.summaryText: Running out of time to snatch the divison title from Minnesota, Spurs can still point to a nine-game win streak -- with an average victory margin of 13.7 points -- that suggests they're looking better than decent as the playoffs approach.

rankings.summaryHtml: Evidence to prove these aren't Wolves of old? KG (the MVP) and Co. are 8-4 against Spurs, Lakers and Kings.
rankings.summaryText: Evidence to prove these aren't Wolves of old? KG (the MVP) and Co. are 8-4 against Spurs, Lakers and Kings.

rankings.summaryHtml: At 19-5 since adding 'Sheed, the only real concern is Detroit's 6-12 record in games decided by three points or less. Only four other playoff teams (Nuggets at 3-9, Nets at 3-7, Spurs at 6-8, Heat at 6-7) are under .500 in those circumstances.

rankings.summaryHtml: Uncle Reg says pendulum has swung in Pistons' favor and away from the only team out there that can win 60 games. We're a little surprised he'd say so, but we'll let the playoffs settle whether or not it's some psychological ploy.
rankings.summaryText: Uncle Reg says pendulum has swung in Pistons' favor and away from the only team out there that can win 60 games. We're a little surprised he'd say so, but we'll let the playoffs settle whether or not it's some psychological ploy.

rankings.summaryHtml: If we overreacted like many did when Lakers routed Kings, we'd be saying Lakers are finished now. But you rely on us as a voice of a reason, so: It's the next drama, in the playoffs, that would be truly worrisome. Not Sunday's inexplicable no-show.

rankings.summaryHtml: For weeks they've looked lifeless, like Kings were waiting for something to spark them into attack mode. Not surprisingly, it was a Lakers visit that woke 'em up.
rankings.summaryText: For weeks they've looked lifeless, like Kings were waiting for something to spark them into attack mode. Not surprisingly, it was a Lakers visit that woke 'em up.

rankings.summaryHtml: On the season's list of unexplained occurences, the disappearance of Dallas' killer instinct on the road is way up there. After going 27-14 in road games each of the past two seasons, now they can't even win at Golden State, falling to 15-25.
rankings.summaryText: On the season's list of unexplained occurences, the disappearance of Dallas' killer instinct on the road is way up there. After going 27-14 in road games each of the past two seasons, now they can't even win at Golden State, falling to 15-25.

rankings.summaryHtml: Committee could not ignore Sloan's coaching, but Hubie made an equally compelling case ... especially when you realize the Grizz's all-time winning percentage before this season wasn't too far over the Mendoza Line at .244.
rankings.summaryText: Committee could not ignore Sloan's coaching, but Hubie made an equally compelling case ... especially when you realize the Grizz's all-time winning percentage before this season wasn't too far over the Mendoza Line at .244.

rankings.summaryHtml: If Nuggets miss out, they'll have every reason to be brokenhearted. They're finishing pretty strong, judging by a six-game home winning streak ... in victories by a combined 83 points.
rankings.summaryText: If Nuggets miss out, they'll have every reason to be brokenhearted. They're finishing pretty strong, judging by a six-game home winning streak ... in victories by a combined 83 points.

rankings.summaryHtml: Utah ain't exactly finishing meekly, either. To keep pace with the Nuggets, Utah has held 38 of its past 40 opponents under 100 points.
rankings.summaryText: Utah ain't exactly finishing meekly, either. To keep pace with the Nuggets, Utah has held 38 of its past 40 opponents under 100 points.

rankings.summaryHtml: Wins in their last two games, at Atlanta and at Miami, would give Nets their first winning road record in their NBA history. Not that it really matters if J-Kidd and K-Mart can't make it through the playoffs.
rankings.summaryText: Wins in their last two games, at Atlanta and at Miami, would give Nets their first winning road record in their NBA history. Not that it really matters if J-Kidd and K-Mart can't make it through the playoffs.

rankings.summaryHtml: The good news: Rockets have avoided that 'historic collapse' you've heard so much about. The bad news: Rockets probably lost their status as a dangerous first-round opponent by coming close to collapsing.
rankings.summaryText: The good news: Rockets have avoided that 'historic collapse' you've heard so much about. The bad news: Rockets probably lost their status as a dangerous first-round opponent by coming close to collapsing.

rankings.summaryHtml: Of course we considered Zach strongly for MIP. But his big improvement was seen in last spring's Dallas series; his outstanding play this season merely built on that jump.

rankings.summaryHtml: If you called Stan Van's team clinching a playoff berth before brother Jeff's team, even if you called it before Heat's 0-7 start ... you're flat-out fibbing. Of course, a 5-15 launch isn't so damaging if you finish 15-3.

rankings.summaryHtml: Since the 16-team playoff format was adopted in 1983-84, no No. 4 seed has ever had a winning percentage below .524. Bucks have to win their final two games just to get to .524.

rankings.summaryHtml: Injuries and controversies submarined these guys again, but facts is facts: As Denver closes in on halting its eight-season playoff drought, Golden State stretched its drought to a league-high 10 straight seasons, despite this current 11-4 spurt.
rankings.summaryText: Injuries and controversies submarined these guys again, but facts is facts: As Denver closes in on halting its eight-season playoff drought, Golden State stretched its drought to a league-high 10 straight seasons, despite this current 11-4 spurt.

rankings.summaryHtml: As bumpy as the second half has been, Hornets don't want this season to end. Not with Floyd barely clinging to his job and not after Hornets went 11-17 against the conference that beckons next season.
rankings.summaryText: As bumpy as the second half has been, Hornets don't want this season to end. Not with Floyd barely clinging to his job and not after Hornets went 11-17 against the conference that beckons next season.

rankings.summaryHtml: If nothing else, Knicks have avoided the shame of missing the playoffs for three straight seasons, which hasn't happened in Gotham since 1985-87. But we're guessing the Nets aren't too impressed.

rankings.summaryHtml: It sounds like Sonics don't want to fire Nate after an injury-filled season, but it also sounds like Nate doesn't really want to stay.

rankings.summaryHtml: Just a hunch, but a team that just backed into the Least playoffs by losing four straight ain't going to upset Indiana this time. But we can still applaud Boston's rally from a 23-36 start.

rankings.summaryHtml: If there's a worthy MIP complaint out there, it's that we neglected to list Joe Johnson as a nominee. He's one of the few bright spots in a mostly dark season in the desert.

rankings.summaryHtml: The playoffs would have been better with LeBron in them, given his 22-5-6 averages since the All-Star break. You suspect he would have made it had Cavs not needed half a season to get the roster tweaked to suit him.

rankings.summaryHtml: They're coming at Iverson from all angles now. Besides the heat he's getting in Philly, neighboring New Jersey rubbed more salt into AI's grill by bringing J-Kidd and K-Mart off the bench in their first games back from injury, a la Timmy Duncan.

rankings.summaryHtml: Still don't know how Hawks lost that Memphis game, but perhaps we shouldn't be surprised. Of its many downfalls this season, Atlanta is 0-6 in OT.

rankings.summaryHtml: Very quietly, Wiz won two out of three games against Atlantic foes in the past week to avoid tying the 1996-97 Celts (1-23) for a thoroughly unwanted record. And after this injury-filled season, Wiz will take it.

rankings.summaryHtml: Who has time to miss MJ when a whole season is spent pining for Ron Artest, Brad Miller and Elton Brand? Trenton Hassell, even.

rankings.summaryHtml: An ugly second half just gets uglier: Toronto has lost six straight at home, 10 of 11 overall and now faces the shame of a 50-loss season.

rankings.summaryHtml: Just in case Clips feel better after reading the Golden State comment ... don't forget that L.A.'s JV holds the NBA record with 15 straight seasons out of the playoffs ... and just extended its current drought to seven.
